knownExistingFinding.detail: All seven lack og:image and twitter:image; already reported by the asset agent, not counted as a newly discovered issue here.

additionalFindings.detail: All seven HTML documents and visible headings are Dutch; all seven titles/descriptions are English. Four decoded titles fall outside the requested 50–60 characters; six descriptions fall outside 140–160.
No breadcrumb navigation and no BreadcrumbList JSON-LD were found on any of the seven pages. Shared server-layout breadcrumbs must not capture stale sibling-route state across client navigation.
Schema pricing conflicts with the preserved visible packages; no justified numeric upper bound is given for the custom quote. Keep visible prices unchanged.
Three structured offers disagree with the four visible format prices. Keep visible prices unchanged.
These are working legacy redirects, but event HTML/schema still link through aliases rather than the canonical public destinations.
All event Open Graph objects omit og:locale; the server HTML and content currently use Dutch. No new translated route is implied.

sharedBackground.pipeline: Direct CSS WebP background; no Next optimizer or RestaurantPhoto picture selection.

limitations: No browser, gallery API, image-body GET, production database or transactional request was made.
Metadata, JSON-LD and initial built-in gallery were observed in raw HTML; uploaded gallery content after hydration was not observed.
No external rich-result or search-engine validation was performed. Existing restaurant/event facts were not independently reverified or expanded.
This audit does not assert that source JPEG sizes equal optimized browser transfer or that the gallery passes/fails its delivered-image budget.
The seven public event URLs have no newly invented English counterpart URLs; absence of paired hreflang was not treated as a defect.
This is a pre-fix scoped audit of the qtEl combined candidate; a subsequent metadata build requires focused revalidation.
